title: Dactyl opaque storage context transport seam
intent: Implement Dactyl issue 64 as the narrow backend-neutral transport seam for Decapod issue 1254: carry a versioned opaque storage context through remote query and atomic requests, ignore it for local storage, preserve existing physical route configuration, and expose typed protocol/authentication failures without adding tenancy, repository, schema, retry, or authorization semantics.
deferred_questions: The inner storage-context payload remains owned by Decapod and Propodus; Dactyl intentionally forwards it without interpretation.
Live Vercel/Neon deployment and cross-repository parity remain downstream proof after the Dactyl transport seam.
